source.verified: Recorded recipe/cache hashes match current files and current HEAD Git blobs. This is a retrospective content binding; original report did not record an immutable SHA.

configuration.method: AST selects the actual buildAppShell viteBuild argument and original declarations/functions; config text is evaluated verbatim on every round.
configuration.candidateOnlyChange: Adds a pre transform for exactly js/runtime/refresh-resource-cache.js. Virtual candidate source, one touched module asserted. No target/group/minifier change.

measurements.origin: Root's recorded three-round results; reviewed script awaits real Vite build(config). Reviewer independently checked report consistency and virtual sources, did not rerun builds.
measurements.checks: Exactly rounds 1/2/3 per variant, identical within variant, 16 chunks and identical recorded graph hash. Both full transformed sources independently reconstructed byte-for-byte and parsed without errors.

graphFingerprint.includes: Sorted relative module-ID sets per emitted chunk; static/dynamic edges mapped to those sets; cold-closure membership. Startup-isolation assertion from actual recipe is executed by probe.
graphFingerprint.excludes: Chunk code, exported bindings, export signatures, bytes, runtime behavior, source/date/null/getter semantics. It is not behavioral equivalence or the full deployment artifact fingerprint.
graphFingerprint.limits: Module IDs are joined with |; edge keys could be undefined if a dependency lacks an emitted chunk. Probe does not retain the full graph or enforce injective keys, so equal hashes are a bounded topology indication, not a universal graph proof.

sourceAndSite.probeSpecificCacheCheck: Probe compares LF-normalized cache source before/after and reports sourceUnchanged=true. Its only explicit writeFile target is external report.json; build write:false and virtual transform do not write site output.
sourceAndSite.currentSiteEvidence: Fresh read-only execution of actual exported artifactFingerprint function matches Before/After current artifact in docs/v16.0.0/performance-evidence/m3-private-hash-pair-ci-20261011.json.
sourceAndSite.limits: Probe report has no all-source or whole-site before/after inventory. Current clean HEAD and matching frozen site supplement provenance; they do not retroactively prove the probe's exact start/end whole-tree bytes.

disposition.bothCandidates: REJECT: all gzip increases by 25 B / 33 B; no material package saving.
disposition.behavioralEquivalence: NOT ESTABLISHED, NOT CLAIMED; candidates rejected on package evidence before behavior qualification.
